neighbours.label: the tokens ' across' and ' true' (esp. in 'come across', 'come true')
fire: I hope you never come across a bear on this trail.
Her dream of opening a bakery finally came true.
We walked across the bridge at sunset.
It is true that the shop closes early on Sundays.
You may come across this word in older novels.
Wishes rarely come true without hard work.
The message did not come across clearly in the email.
Their fears about the storm turned out to be true.
quiet: I hope you never run into a bear on this trail.
Her dream of opening a bakery finally happened.
We walked over the bridge at sunset.
It is likely that the shop closes early on Sundays.
You may find this word in older novels.
Wishes rarely succeed without hard work.
The message did not sound clear in the email.
Their fears about the storm turned out to be right.

notes: Card: ' across' x20, ' true' x12 of top 32, mostly after 'come'.
